hybrid_leverage_corollary.consequence: core variation alone neither improves the local principal contraction nor repairs positive conductor-fibre assembly
hybrid_leverage_corollary.reason: the constant mode survives with multiplier |C| and the principal observation kills every nonconstant mode

operator_theorem.even_mode_bijection: root characters modulo the quadratic character map bijectively under squaring to even characters; t maps to exponent 2t
operator_theorem.full_incidence_operator: K_C F(x)=sum_(c in C) F(x*c^-2,c) from Omega*C to Omega
operator_theorem.full_incidence_spectrum: K_C*K_C^*=|C|I; rank m and kernel dimension m(|C|-1) for nonempty C
operator_theorem.interpretation: core variation can create nonconstant rank but cannot improve the top local norm; complete sign-pair occupancy collapses to rank one
operator_theorem.kernel: span of exactly those owner Fourier modes t with B_C(zeta_m^-t)=0
operator_theorem.nonconstant_spectral_mass: m*sum_j(beta_j^2)-|C|^2; it is zero exactly when beta is constant
operator_theorem.operator_norm_for_subsets: |C|, always attained on the constant mode; other modes may tie
operator_theorem.shared_owner_operator: T_C f(x)=sum_(c in C) f(x*c^-2)=K_C D_C f on Omega=a*(F_p^*)^2

owner_incompleteness_theorem.meaning: a complete owner coset is exactly Fourier diagonal; an incomplete owner set mixes modes through, and only through, its nontrivial multiplicative Fourier coefficients

owner_incompleteness_control.mode_mixing_formula: <e_t,T_C M_A e_s>=lambda_t*ahat_A(s-t)/m; the density-subtracted defect deletes s=t and retains exactly the nonzero owner Fourier frequencies

full_incidence_pushforward.kernel: for each physical x, source amplitudes on the |C| preimages sum to zero independently
